source_metadata: Saved open PR metadata from preceding audit; all source heads verified against freshly fetched batch/<PR> refs. Declared bases preserved from metadata so own-delta merge bases are reproducible.
approved_policy: Fractional min/max constraints are allowed on integer-valued columns using JSON Schema semantics; integrate #2583 raw drafts/submit guards consistently with #2540.
global_reconciliation_notes: Do not merge legacy source heads wholesale. Apply own_delta_merge_base_sha..source_head_sha; preserve parent branches and review history.
Use canonical @tomic/ui implementations; legacy relative components/Input, Popover, Row and utility copies must not be resurrected.
browser/table/src/index.ts is additive across sources. Keep existing clean exports and new behavior exports without duplicate declarations.
Avoid replacing .github/workflows/table-package.yml wholesale from legacy snapshots; merge test lists/build inputs and preserve separate package/Atomic adapter validation.
Translation catalogs must retain develop additions and all currently visible strings; final catalog verification on combined tree is required.
Modified paths absent from foundation may be created by preceding dependencies; these lists are warnings for integration ordering, not proof of accidental missing files.
All 57 review vehicles remain open at fresh verification. No source head changed since inventory except #2597, where this task published the same CI-only repair now included here.
Recovered missing clean foundation prerequisites ViewTabs and parsed-editor text drafts explicitly using canonical shared UI; did not merge the legacy full-page ancestor.
Adapted foundation tests to source API changes while retaining their behavior: raw numeric text rather than spinbutton, preserved extra presets, row-action draft callback, strict precision errors.
The batch does not complete the full TablePage/ELFA port. #2377 retains unique app ports and is not a closure candidate.

Combined local tests, production desktop/mobile checks and normal commit hooks pass; no full shared CI was dispatched for this batch. The separate #2597 hosted run failed an unchanged Flutter bridge outbox assertion after downstream passed. Closure still requires trekmeester acceptance and validation.
